product.name: Monoprice Commercial Audio Desktop Conferencing and Paging Microphone with On/Off Button (NO LOGO)
product.description: This condenser microphone is an ideal solution for meetings, conferences, and public address needs. It features a gooseneck design, which allows you to angle it to the ideal speaking position. The microphone is powered using two AAA batteries (sold separately) in the base or by connecting to an XLR jack with +48V Phantom Power.
